summary: Gogoro Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on November 12, 2026, attaching its Q3 2026 earnings press release dated November 11, 2026, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly results announcement, not a special situation: IFRS and non-IFRS gross margins both reached 24.4% versus 12.2% and 22.2% a year earlier, and operating cash flow rose 8.8% year-over-year to $27.9 million for the first nine months. Updates cover Luna and EZZY product lines, Vietnam expansion via the Castrol Gogoro Mobility joint venture, and delivery-platform pilots. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed; no deal is in play and no risk-arb angle applies.
